intro: Medininagar, still called Daltonganj by many, is the headquarters of Palamu district in western Jharkhand. Buyers here sometimes assume that a manufacturer based in Maharashtra will not deliver this far. We do. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory, about 1,260 km away, and sends it by road to schools, colonies and public grounds across Jharkhand.

One of the structures in our wooden NexLev castle range is even named Palamu, after the district. Whatever you choose, the process is the same. You share the site size, the age group and photos, and we suggest equipment with a layout drawing that marks the safe play area. Once you approve the layout and quote, we manufacture, dispatch and install it.

sections.h: How delivery works for a distant town
sections.html:
Distance changes the planning more than the product. Because a second trip is costly for everyone, we confirm measurements, ground conditions and access before manufacturing starts. Tell us if the site is up a narrow lane, behind a school gate or on uneven ground, and mention whether you prefer grouted or self-standing installation.

Installation is done by our own team or a dealer in eastern India. Keep the area cleared and, for grouting, have water and space for concrete work available on the day. You can see the castle structure that shares the district's name on our Palamu product page, or look at the full NexLev castle range. Adult fitness is on our Medininagar outdoor gym page.

faq.q: Does FunPlay deliver to Medininagar and Palamu district?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment by road from our Vasai factory and install it through our own team or a dealer in eastern India.

faq.q: What should we prepare before the installation team arrives?
faq.a: Clear the play area, confirm vehicle access to the site and, for grouted installation, keep water and space for concrete work ready.

faq.q: Is the Palamu structure named after the district?
faq.a: Palamu is one of the wooden castle structures in our NexLev Series. Ask us for its details and a layout drawing if you have space for a larger play tower.

intro: Meerut makes a large share of India's sports goods, from cricket bats to footballs, and its schools and cantonment colonies take outdoor activity seriously. Older children here quickly outgrow toddler slides and spring riders, and they want something that tests strength and balance. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory, about 1,170 km away, and sends it to western UP by road.

We supply schools, societies, clubs and public parks across Meerut. Tell us the age group, the size of the space and how many children play at once. We will propose equipment with the safe play area marked on a layout drawing, and once you approve the layout and quote, our team or a dealer in north India installs it.

sections.h: Active play for children aged 8 to 12
sections.html:
For older children, climbing equipment does the most work. Rope nets, rock climbing walls and balance bridges build grip, coordination and confidence, and several children can use them at once. Our climbers range includes nets, rock climbers and balancing beams, and the NexLev Escapade structures add adventure routes for larger grounds.

Meerut swings from hot summers to cold, foggy winters. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded holds cope with both, and play rope carries our 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Lay rubber flooring under every climber. For teenagers and adults, add machines from our outdoor gym range in Meerut.

faq.q: What playground equipment suits older children in Meerut?
faq.a: Climbers, rope nets, rock walls and balance equipment. They build strength and coordination and hold the interest of children aged roughly 8 to 12, who find toddler pieces too easy.

faq.q: Do you install equipment in Meerut Cantonment and the city?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road from Vasai and install through our own team or a dealer in north India, grouted or self-standing.

faq.q: Is the play rope covered by warranty?
faq.a: Yes. Play rope carries a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects, along with galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts and composite laminates.

intro: Mehsana in north Gujarat is a dairy and oilfield district with hot, dry summers and bright sun for most of the year. Schools, housing societies and company colonies here often ask us about colour: which shades stay attractive in strong sunlight, and which suit a school uniform or a society's look. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at Vasai, Maharashtra, about 470 km from Mehsana, and delivers it by road.

Colour is one of the easier decisions once the layout is done. Send us the site size, the age group and photos, and we will suggest equipment and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing. When you approve the layout and quote, we manufacture in your chosen shades and install through our team or a dealer in Gujarat.

sections.h: Choosing colours for a sunny site
sections.html:
Our roto-moulded parts come in more than 15 colour shades. The colour is part of the plastic itself, so it does not chip off the way paint does. On a site in full sun, lighter tones stay cooler to touch than very dark ones, so use them for slide beds and deck panels that children sit on.

Many schools match the playground to their uniform or logo, and builders often pick a palette that suits the building's front. Two or three colours usually look better than a rainbow. Our Castle Crest and Robo Romp themed sets show how colour can carry a theme. See also our Mehsana outdoor gym page.

faq.q: How many colours can we choose from?
faq.a: Our roto-moulded parts come in more than 15 shades. We can match a school's or society's colours where the range allows, and design customisation is available on request.

faq.q: Will the colours fade in Mehsana's sun?
faq.a: The colour runs through the roto-moulded plastic rather than sitting on the surface as paint, so it does not chip. Lighter shades also stay cooler in direct sun.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Mehsana and north Gujarat?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in Gujarat.

intro: Mira Bhayandar is about 10 km from our factory in Vasai, just across the creek, so it is one of the easiest places in India for us to supply. Most enquiries here come from high-rise housing societies whose play area sits on a podium, a terrace or a narrow strip between towers. FunPlay Systems designs, manufactures and installs outdoor playground equipment for exactly these sites.

We have installed a playground for Raymond in Thane, a few kilometres further along. For your society or school, share the area available, the age group and photos, and tell us whether the space is on natural ground or on a slab. We will send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked and install with our own team once you approve.

sections.h: Play areas on podiums and terraces
sections.html:
A podium or terrace slab is usually waterproofed, and drilling or digging into it can cause leaks in the floor below. On such sites we generally recommend a self-standing installation, where the equipment rests on its own base without breaking the slab. Check the load the slab can take with your structural engineer before you finalise larger pieces.

Rubber flooring over the slab cushions falls and protects the waterproofing. Mumbai's monsoon is heavy from June to September, so make sure the podium drains do not sit inside the play area. A compact Play Lands structure suits most podiums. Our Raymond, Thane project shows local work, and the Mira Bhayandar outdoor gym page covers fitness.

faq.q: Can playground equipment go on a podium or terrace?
faq.a: Yes, usually with a self-standing installation that does not break the waterproofed slab. Confirm the slab's load capacity with your structural engineer for larger structures.

faq.q: How close is your factory to Mira Bhayandar?
faq.a: About 10 km. Our factory is in Vasai East, just across the creek, so the equipment has only a short road trip to your site.

faq.q: What flooring should go on a podium play area?
faq.a: Rubber flooring. It cushions falls, protects the waterproofing underneath and dries quickly after rain. Keep drain outlets clear of the play area.

intro: Miryalaguda in Nalgonda district is one of Telangana's busiest rice-milling towns, and its schools and growing residential layouts are where most playground enquiries come from. The question we hear most often is whether to buy one multi play system or several separate pieces. FunPlay Systems manufactures both at our factory in Vasai, about 760 km away, and sends them to Telangana by road.

The right answer depends on your ground, your budget and who will use it. Send us the size of the space, the age group and a few photos. We will compare the options on a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, and once you approve, we manufacture and install through our team or a dealer in south India.

sections.h: Multi play system or separate pieces?
sections.html:
A multi play system combines slides, climbers, decks and tunnels in one structure. It uses less space for the amount of play, has a single safe zone and looks like a proper playground from day one. Our Play Lands range is a good place to compare sizes.

Separate pieces such as swings, see-saws and merry-go-rounds spread children across a larger ground and can be bought a few at a time. Many schools in Telangana combine the two: one structure in the centre, with swings and a see-saw around it. Summers here are very hot, so plan shade for whichever you choose. See our Miryalaguda outdoor gym page too.

faq.q: Is a multi play system better than individual equipment?
faq.a: It suits smaller grounds and gives more play per square foot. Individual pieces suit larger grounds and phased budgets. Many schools combine both on one layout.

faq.q: Do you supply schools in Nalgonda district?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment by road from Vasai and install it with our team or a dealer in south India, grouted or self-standing.

faq.q: Can you compare both options for our ground?
faq.a: Yes. Share the measurements and photos, and we can show a multi play layout and an individual-equipment layout so you can decide.

intro: Mirzapur stands where the Vindhya hills meet the Ganga, and in many parts of the district the ground under the topsoil is hard rock. That changes how playground equipment is installed. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory in Maharashtra, about 1,180 km away, and sends it by road to schools, colonies and parks in eastern Uttar Pradesh.

We plan the installation method before anything is manufactured. Send us photos of the ground, tell us whether you have hit rock when digging before, and share the site size and the age group. We will suggest equipment, mark the safe play area on a layout drawing and arrange installation with our team or a dealer in north India.

sections.h: Installing on rocky or uneven ground
sections.html:
Where rock lies close to the surface, deep pits for grouting may not be practical. A self-standing installation, where the equipment sits on its own base, can work on firm, level rock or a concrete pad. On uneven ground, level a pad first, because a structure that leans even slightly puts strain on its joints.

Rock and hard ground are unforgiving to fall on, so lay rubber flooring under and around every piece. Lower equipment such as spring riders and see-saws suits a first play area on a difficult site. For adults, see our outdoor gym equipment in Mirzapur.

faq.q: Can you install playground equipment on rocky ground in Mirzapur?
faq.a: Yes. Where digging is difficult, we usually suggest a self-standing installation on level rock or a concrete pad, with rubber flooring around it. We decide this from photos of your ground.

faq.q: Why does the ground need to be level?
faq.a: Equipment that leans puts uneven strain on its joints and can affect how slides and swings work. Level the pad before installation, and check it again after the first monsoon.

faq.q: Do you supply eastern Uttar Pradesh?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road from our Vasai factory and install through our own team or a dealer in north India.

intro: Moradabad is India's brass city, and many of the people who buy playground equipment here know metal finishing better than most. They ask good questions about coatings, joints and rust. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,210 km away, and sends it to western Uttar Pradesh by road for schools, societies, clubs and parks.

We are happy to explain how our equipment is built before you buy. Share the site size, the age group and some photos, and we will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked. After you approve the layout and quote, we manufacture, dispatch and install through our own team or a dealer in north India.

sections.html:
Painted mild steel looks fine on delivery, but once the paint is scratched, water reaches the bare metal and rust spreads under the coating. Galvanised steel is coated in zinc, which protects the steel even where the surface gets scratched. That is why our frames and posts are galvanised pipe, and why we give them a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects.

Slides, panels and seats are roto-moulded plastic made in our own facility, so they cannot rust at all. Moradabad's monsoon and damp winters are hard on poor finishes. Ask us about the materials used in any structure you shortlist, such as our Forestia or Clown Capade sets.

faq.q: What is the difference between painted and galvanised steel?
faq.a: Paint protects only while it is intact. Galvanised steel has a zinc coating that keeps protecting the metal even when the surface is scratched, so it resists rust much longer outdoors.

faq.q: Do you make the plastic parts yourselves?
faq.a: Yes. Design, roto-moulding and fabrication are done in-house at our Vasai factory, and every product goes through our own quality inspection.

faq.q: Do you install in Moradabad?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road and install through our own team or a dealer in north India, grouted or self-standing depending on your ground.

intro: Morbi is the ceramic tile capital of India, and when a factory colony or school here builds a play area, the first instinct is often to finish the ground with tiles. Under playground equipment, that is the wrong choice. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 440 km from Morbi, and supplies schools, societies and industrial townships across Saurashtra.

We help you plan the surface along with the equipment. Share the site size, the age group and a few photos, and we will suggest equipment and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing. Once you approve the layout and quote, we manufacture and dispatch by road, and our team or a dealer in Gujarat installs it.

sections.h: What should go under playground equipment
sections.html:
Tiles, granite and plain concrete are hard and slippery when wet, and a fall from a swing or slide onto them can cause serious injury. Inside the safe play area, use an impact-absorbing surface instead. We supply rubber flooring that cushions falls, drains well and does not get slippery after rain.

Tiles still have a place. Use them for the walkway around the play area, for seating zones and for the paths that reach it. Morbi's summers are hot, and rubber flooring stays more comfortable than stone in the sun. Popular first pieces include swing sets and merry-go-rounds. For workers and residents, see our Morbi outdoor gym page.

faq.q: Can we use tiles under playground equipment?
faq.a: Not inside the safe play area. Tiles are hard and slippery when wet. Use rubber flooring under the equipment and keep tiles for paths and seating areas around it.

faq.q: Do you supply rubber flooring with the equipment?
faq.a: Yes. We supply rubber flooring for play areas along with the playground equipment, and we show where it should go on the layout drawing.

faq.q: Do you install playground equipment in Morbi?
faq.a: Yes. We send it by road from Vasai and install with our team or a dealer in Gujarat, grouted or self-standing.

intro: Morena lies in the Chambal region of northern Madhya Pradesh, close to the Rajasthan border, and its summers are among the hottest in central India. For a school or park here, the real question is how to make a playground usable in May and June. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 950 km away, and sends it by road.

We supply schools, colonies, municipal parks and private institutions. Send us the size of the site, the age group and a few photos that show where the sun falls during the day. We will suggest equipment and shade, and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked before you approve a quote for your site.

sections.h: Adding shade to a hot playground
sections.html:
In a Chambal summer, unshaded slides and decks become too hot to touch by late morning. Shade is the most useful addition you can make. A pergola or gazebo from our garden decor range can sit beside the play area as a waiting spot for parents and a cool place for children between turns.

Place toddler equipment in the shadiest part of the site, since small children sit and crawl on surfaces more than older ones. Mature trees help, but keep equipment clear of overhanging branches. Winters here are cold, and galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts handle that swing in temperature. See our Morena outdoor gym page for adults.

faq.q: How can we keep a playground usable in Morena's summer?
faq.a: Add shade beside or over the play area, put toddler pieces in the shadiest spot and use rubber flooring, which stays cooler than concrete. Morning and evening play times also help.

faq.q: Do you supply gazebos and pergolas as well?
faq.a: Yes. Our CoreCraft garden decor range includes benches, gazebos and pergolas that can be planned into the same layout drawing as the play equipment.

faq.q: Can you deliver to the Chambal region?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment by road from our Vasai factory and install with our team or a dealer in central India.

intro: Motihari, the headquarters of East Champaran in north Bihar, has a growing number of private schools and residential colonies, and many of them are buying playground equipment for the first time. If you have never ordered from a manufacturer before, the process can seem unclear. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory in Maharashtra, about 1,470 km away, and we keep the process simple.

You deal with one contact at FunPlay from the first call to the installation. You can reach our sales team on +91 902 830 2266 or at sales@funplaysystems.com, Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM. Below is what happens after you get in touch with us, step by step.

sections.html:
1. Share the length and width of your site, the age group of the children and a few photos.
  2. We suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.
  3. You approve the layout and the quote, or ask for changes.
  4. We manufacture the equipment at our Vasai factory and dispatch it by road.
  5. Our team or a dealer in eastern India installs it, grouted or self-standing.

North Bihar's plains get heavy monsoon rain, so mention if your ground holds water and we will plan a raised base. Popular first choices include swings and a small Play Lands structure.

faq.q: What information do you need to prepare a quote?
faq.a: The site's length and width, the age group of the children and a few photos. With these we prepare a layout drawing and a quote.

faq.q: Can you install playground equipment in Motihari?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment from Vasai by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in eastern India. Nearby towns in East Champaran are covered the same way.

faq.q: What warranty comes with the equipment?
faq.a: Three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts, covering manufacturing defects.

intro: Munger is an old town on the south bank of the Ganga, with river breezes, humid summers and a strong monsoon. Schools and colonies here want playground equipment that stays in good condition for years, and that depends as much on simple upkeep as on how it was made. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,540 km away, and delivers it to Bihar by road.

Every installation comes with maintenance steps from us at handover. Share your site size, the age group and some photos, and we will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked. Our team or a dealer in eastern India installs the equipment once you approve the layout and quote.

sections.html:
• Weekly: sweep the flooring, remove litter and check that nothing sharp or broken is lying in the play area.
  • Monthly: check bolts, chains, swing seats and spring riders for wear or looseness.
  • After the monsoon: wash down all surfaces, look for soil washed away from footings and check drainage.

Keep a short log, and call our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or write to aftersales@funplaysystems.com if anything needs attention. Springs and bearings carry a 1-year warranty, and galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts carry 3 years. Simple pieces such as see-saws are easy to inspect. Fitness options are on our Munger outdoor gym page.

faq.q: How often should playground equipment be inspected?
faq.a: A quick check every week, a closer look at bolts, chains and springs every month, and a full wash-down and footing check after the monsoon.

faq.q: Who do we call if something breaks?
faq.a: Our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or aftersales@funplaysystems.com. Share photos of the damage so we can assess it.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Munger?
faq.a: Yes. Equipment is made at our Vasai factory, sent by road and installed by our own team or a dealer in eastern India.

intro: Muzaffarnagar sits in the sugarcane belt of western Uttar Pradesh, and many schools here, in town and in the surrounding villages, have large open grounds. Space is rarely the problem. The challenge is placing equipment sensibly on a big field shared with cricket, assemblies and sometimes stray animals. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory, about 1,220 km away, and delivers it by road.

Share a photo of your whole ground, its rough measurements and how it is used through the day. We will suggest where the play area should go, what equipment suits your students and how much safe play area each piece needs, all marked on a layout drawing. Our team or a dealer in north India installs once you approve.

sections.h: Placing a playground on a large school ground
sections.html:
Put the play area near the classrooms used by younger students, so teachers can watch it and small children do not cross the whole field. Keep it well away from the cricket pitch, where hard balls fly. A low fence around the play area keeps animals out and marks the zone clearly.

Trees give welcome shade in the hot months, but place equipment clear of overhanging branches. Western UP has cold winters and hot summers, and galvanised frames with roto-moulded parts handle both. A larger ground can take a structure from our NexLev Series alongside merry-go-rounds and swings. See our Muzaffarnagar outdoor gym page too.

faq.q: Where should the playground go on a big school ground?
faq.a: Near the classrooms of younger students, away from the cricket pitch, with a low fence around it. We can suggest a position if you send a photo of the whole ground.

faq.q: Do you supply village schools near Muzaffarnagar?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver anywhere reachable by road and install with our own team or a dealer in north India, grouted or self-standing.

faq.q: Is a fence needed around the play area?
faq.a: It is a good idea on open grounds. A low fence keeps stray animals out, marks the safe zone and helps teachers supervise.
